types.name: bool
types.description: Canonical logical false or true; never host truthiness.

types.name: error
types.description: Typed language error payload independent of a backend return convention.

types.name: panic-info
types.description: Typed catchable runtime panic payload on a channel disjoint from language errors and hard traps.

types.name: type-variable
types.description: Registry meta-type resolved by a verified function or block signature.

effects.name: call
effects.description: Invoke a sealed in-program function with its declared effects.

effects.name: target-query
effects.description: Read one immutable value from the bound XrTargetProfile.

effects.name: panic
effects.description: Typed catchable panic continuation publication, distinct from business errors and hard traps.

capabilities.name: profile.pointer-width
capabilities.description: The bound target profile publishes an exact 32- or 64-bit pointer width.

traps.name: integer-overflow
traps.description: A checked signed integer result is outside [-2^63, 2^63-1].

traps.name: integer-division-overflow
traps.description: i64 minimum divided by -1 has no i64 result.

traps.name: explicit-trap
traps.description: The program explicitly publishes a deterministic trap.

traps.name: profile-unavailable
traps.description: The required immutable target-profile field is absent or invalid.

traps.name: variant-tag-mismatch
traps.description: A variant payload projection names a different variant than the value carries.

retired_operation_ids.reason: Permanent tombstone proving active IDs cannot reuse retired values.
